_doc: SAMPLE / ILLUSTRATIVE. Proposed shape of the brand node in the Arc Graph. Hypothetical brand 'Halo Nutrition' (CPG wellness). Purpose: confirm with Typeface which of these fields already exist in Brand Kit, which are derived, and which are absent.
_confirm_with_typeface: Which fields below already exist in Brand Hub / Brand Kit today?
Which are free text vs. structured and machine-checkable?
Who writes them: brand team at the customer, or inferred from uploaded assets?
What is the staleness / review cadence on each?
Is there a confidence or provenance value attached to each field?

governance.source_of_truth: Brand book v6.2 (PDF, 88pp) + Figma library 'Halo DS 3.0'

logo.clear_space_rule: 1.0x the height of the 'H' mark on all four sides
prohibited: placing over a face or over product label text
mark_only at retail media placements (retailers require full lockup)

prohibited_hex_neighbourhoods: #FF0000 red family (reserved for recall / safety comms)

tolerance.note: how far a generated colour may drift from token before it is flagged

pairing_rules.reason: fails WCAG AA at body size

prohibited: more than 2 type sizes per creative

imagery.style: natural daylight, shallow depth of field, matte finish, real people mid-motion

product_rendering.rule: pack shot must be the approved render, never AI-regenerated

people.diversity_requirement: campaign-level cast must span >=3 skin tones and >=2 age brackets

voice.emoji_policy: permitted on TikTok and Instagram Stories only, max 1 per line

claims_and_legal._note: This is the block that most needs to exist and most often does not. Ask Typeface whether anything like it is held today.

prohibited_claims.reason: Amazon and Walmart prohibit unsubstantiated superlatives

mandatory_disclaimers.text: These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
mandatory_disclaimers.placement: within creative, not landing page only

FR.mandatory_footer: Pour votre sante, pratiquez une activite physique reguliere.

retailer_specific_naming.amazon_us: Halo Nutrition Daily Protein Powder, Vanilla, 30 Servings

co_branding_rules.requirement: Walmart badge bottom-right, 'Available at Walmart' lockup, no competitor retailer visible
no Amazon logo in Sponsored Brands creative, no 'Prime' reference without approval
